"""Game engine for simplified Monopoly Go!"""

import random

from board import (BOARD_SIZE, CHANCE_CARDS, GO_BONUS, JAIL_FINE, JAIL_MAX_TURNS,
                   JAIL_POS, build_tiles)
from player import Player


def ask(prompt):
    try:
        return input(prompt).strip().lower() in ("y", "yes")
    except (EOFError, OSError):
        return False


class Game:
    def __init__(self, names):
        self.tiles = build_tiles()
        self.players = [Player(n) for n in names]
        self.round_no = 0
        self.deck = []
        self.discards = []
        self.reset_deck()

    # ---------- deck ----------
    def reset_deck(self):
        self.deck = list(CHANCE_CARDS)
        random.shuffle(self.deck)
        self.discards = []

    def draw_card(self):
        if not self.deck:
            self.deck, self.discards = self.discards, []
            random.shuffle(self.deck)
        return self.deck.pop()

    def return_card(self, card):
        self.deck.insert(0, card)  # bottom of deck

    # ---------- money ----------
    def gain(self, p, amount):
        p.cash += amount
        print("  %s gains $%d (cash $%d)." % (p.name, amount, p.cash))

    def charge(self, p, amount, to=None):
        """Take up to `amount` from p. Returns True if fully paid."""
        paid = min(p.cash, amount)
        p.cash -= paid
        if to is not None:
            to.cash += paid
        if paid < amount:
            self.bankrupt(p, to)
            return False
        print("  %s pays $%d%s (cash $%d)." % (p.name, amount, " to %s" % to.name if to else "", p.cash))
        return True

    def bankrupt(self, p, creditor=None):
        p.bankrupt = True
        for t in p.owned:
